items.name: base
items.title: GDOP base design system
items.description: All GDOP colors and design tokens (scales, semantic, status tones, radius, elevation) with Tailwind v4 theme wiring.
items.docs: Add `@import "./base.css";` after `@import "tailwindcss";` in your globals.css, and remove the default shadcn color variables it replaces. Using a src/ directory? Move the file to src/app/base.css.
